_comment: Query sets for corpus-bench.py, keyed by corpus name then by query CLASS.
Only the synthetic corpora are checked in: a query string is vault vocabulary, and the
two real vaults this tool was developed against are private. To bench your own vault,
add an entry with the same five classes and point --corpus at your built page.
one-term   — a word that hits a good fraction of ids
two-term   — two words that hit DIFFERENT notes; this is the class v2.18.0 returned an
empty dropdown for while lighting the graph up
three-term — coverage ranking has something to sort by
punct-only — no letter or digit in the query. queryTerms() falls back to the raw parts,
so a token like '.' that appears in every body drags the whole corpus into
the pool. That is the worst case, and it is measured on purpose
no-hit     — empty pool, so the miss path and the semantic fallback are the ones timed
